technical_cautions: NCCL2.32.3 and Nov2026Megatron snapshot are supplemental, not lecture/A2 dependency pins.
Simple ring/tree timing ignores contention/reduction compute and is explicitly not measured. All traffic tables distinguish per-rank send, receive, endpoint sum, global send and physical byte-hop.
Double binary tree is not naive full-vector tree; non-power-of-two limits belong to schedules, not collective semantics.
FSDP2 parameter-lifetime example assumes reshard_after_forward=True; default/root behavior can differ.
DCP training-safe staging and final save completion are distinct; original application-level complete-generation protocol does not assert generic atomic filesystem/object-store transactions.
World-size resharding is not exact RNG/data/optimizer trajectory replay; global batch/data consumption rules must be redefined explicitly.
Megatron pinned token-dispatch table line335 contradictory allgather/no-inter-GPU-token-movement wording rejected; no silent adoption.
MoE capacity formula/rounding and per-assignment traffic are declared teaching models; deduplication/padding/precision/backends can change actual traffic.
